speaker: Rajesh
text: Okay. So, Saturday night, can I count on my posse? Oh, okay, Leonard?

speaker: Howard
text: Gee, I'd love to, Raj, but I can't make it. Sheldon?

speaker: Penny
text: Here you go, Raj. You might want to drink this one slowly. What were you guys talking about?

speaker: Rajesh
text: Uh, uh, no, I can't, no. Oh, there's a reception for my magazine article on Saturday.

speaker: Penny
text: You guys aren't going? I can't believe me. Raj is celebrating a tremendous accomplishment. You're not even going to be there to support him?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I can make it, but I won't. A tremendous accomplishment would be if the planetary body he discovered were plummeting toward Earth, and he exploded it with his mind.

speaker: Howard
text: That would be cool. I'd go to that reception.

speaker: Penny
text: Come on, this is huge. Raj is going to be in People Magazine, and he didn't even have to knock up one of the Spear sisters.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Would you like to go with me?

speaker: Penny
text: Of course I would. I would be honored. Shame on you guys.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Look at that. I got a date with Benny.

speaker: Rajesh
text: I can't believe it took you a whole year.

speaker: Rajesh
text: Hey, buddy. I'm going to be in People Magazine.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Call me when you're on the cover.
